scenes.title: That Jamaica Airbnb looks good on gross. Check what's left after costs.
scenes.vo: Looking at an Airbnb in Jamaica? The gross figure isn't what lands in your account.
Sellers quote gross: nightly rate times nights booked. Cleaning, fees and management all come off after.

So put the deal in the Deal Analyser. This Ocho Rios example, a hundred and seventy-five thousand pounds cash at ninety-four pounds a night, shows about one thousand and three pounds a month cashflow.
That's the number to judge a deal on. Follow for more ways to check a Jamaica deal.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
